clips.text: Your body is 60% water — and fewer than 100 people on Earth are allergic to it. One drop of rain, and their skin breaks out in hives.
No hot shower. No swim. No walk in the rain. Tessa Hansen-Smith showers twice a month — and her own tears break her out too.
Doctors tested every kind of water. Tap, distilled, sea, rain. Every one raised the hives. It was the water itself.
The leading theory: water reacts with the oils in your skin, and your mast cells dump histamine. Sixty years on, nobody has proven it.
There is no cure. One teenage girl was helped by a drug called omalizumab. One case. Hope, not a treatment.
Your body is 60% water — and fewer than 100 people on Earth are allergic to it. What would you miss first?
